column3: An event that stops the normal route: X1 to X7. The case goes to a named handler
A step in a route set reached when something goes wrong in that route, such as a rejected filing or a missed deadline
Time in the current state. Paused while a deviation is open
Time to the earliest date a legal claim expires. Never paused
No one contacts the customer while it is in force. Statutory notices still go
A deviation is an event listener that pauses the stage and starts the handling tasks
